Looking for a place with a good atmosphere in Jamsil Saenae
I visited McHope, which is famous for its draft beer, and the atmosphere inside was also good.
It was really good and the snacks were really varied!!
I wanted chicken and beer, so I ordered fried chicken and draft beer.
I ate it and the chicken was really crispy and delicious.
The owner is Jo Ju-sa.

You can also watch sports games on the screen inside the store.

Next time, I have to come for a company dinner!!

reviews.author: Yuhee Kim
reviews.text:
It’s the perfect place to have a beer on the terrace! 🍺 In spring and fall, the atmosphere is perfect thanks to the cool night breeze, soft lighting and music, so it's great for a date with your lover or a casual gathering with friends. 😊
I also liked the fact that the store was spacious and had rooms so I could use it comfortably for company dinners or group gatherings. It was convenient to make a reservation in advance through Naver. 📅Highly recommended, especially to those who like sports! ⚽ It’s fun to watch baseball and soccer games on a large beam projector. There are channels like SPOTV so you can watch your favorite games without missing them, so it's perfect for an after-party after the game.
It's right near Jamsil Baseball Stadium, so it's the perfect place to watch baseball and have a beer! After drinking a beer here, I feel like I'll come back often because I'll feel relieved from a tiring day. I'll come again next time! 😄
